hero.welcome: My name is Louka Altdorf Reynes!

intro.description: From scoping to production, I design SaaS products, build their applications and bring AI into practical use.

about.title: About me
about.location: Based in Lille · 4 years of experience with SaaS products in production
about.description: I connect business needs with technical delivery: architecture, backend, frontend, deployment and team coordination. My work brings together application development, AI integration and cloud or self-hosted infrastructure.

points: End-to-end delivery of B2B projects and internal products: requirements, specifications, estimates, backlog and delivery tracking.
Design of Pitly, a vehicle maintenance PWA, and prototyping of Lain, a mental-health-focused matching application.
Web development, API integration and service operations: CI/CD, containers, monitoring and alerting.
Led BoB from idea to public MVP with a team of 3, covering UX/UI, microservices architecture and marketing.
Built AI-powered quotes and Factur-X pro forma invoices from WhatsApp voice messages using Python and FastAPI.
Product Ownership and OKR tracking increased iteration velocity by 20 %. Azure/GCP infrastructure and blue-green deployments reduced regressions by 30 %.
Refactored the payment initiation service into a PSD2-compliant NestJS API suited to a microservices architecture.
Integrated Visa/Mastercard payments and a responsive 3-D Secure flow, improving acceptance by 20 %. Automated banking webhooks and reconciliation.
Built a WhatsApp chatbot, LangGraph conversational agents and a document-based RAG pipeline deployed on GCP.
Introduced to Java and web development within a software team.
Built a proof-of-concept web module to automate internal reporting.
